title: A comparison of knot point screening algorithms for highly adaptive lasso
abstract: arXiv:2611.29270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Highly adaptive lasso (HAL) is a nonparametric regression estimator with a rate of convergence $n^{-1/3}(\log n)^{d/2}$, where the data dimension $d$ only appears in the power of the log of sample size. This fast rate is crucial for many causal inference tasks, where efficient estimation typically requires nuisance parameters to be estimated at a specific rate. HAL achieves this rate and, when paired with semiparametrically efficient estimators -- such as those constructed using targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE) -- can be used to develop efficient estimators. Beyond causal inference, HAL is applicable to a wide range of supervised machine learning tasks. The procedure for HAL involves first performing a basis expansion on the original design matrix $X$ and then computing a lasso solution path. Cross-validation is used to select the optimal $L_1$-norm for the coefficients. For datasets with all continuous covariates and no t

translated_title: 高度自适应Lasso的结点筛选算法比较
translated_abstract: 高度自适应lasso（HAL）是一种非参数回归估计量，其收敛速度为 $n^{-1/3}(\log n)^{d/2}$，其中数据维度 $d$ 仅出现在样本量对数的幂次中。这一快速收敛速度对许多因果推断任务至关重要，因为在这些任务中，有效估计通常要求干扰参数以特定的速度被估计。HAL 能够达到这一收敛速度，并且当与半参数有效估计量（例如通过目标最大似然估计（TMLE）构建的估计量）相结合时，可用于开发有效估计量。除因果推断外，HAL 还适用于广泛的监督机器学习任务。HAL 的实施过程包括首先对原始设计矩阵 $X$ 进行基展开，然后计算 lasso 解路径，并使用交叉验证来选择系数的最优 $L_1$ 范数。对于所有协变量均为连续变量且没有截断的数据集……
tldr: 本文比较了高度自适应lasso（HAL）中不同的结点筛选算法，旨在保持其快速收敛率的同时提升该非参数回归估计量的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper compares different knot point screening algorithms for the highly adaptive lasso (HAL), aiming to improve the computational efficiency of this nonparametric regression estimator while preserving its fast convergence rate.
